title: Pandemic Legacy: Season 0
subtitle: Cold War 1962 espionage thriller and covert CIA operations against Soviet bioweapons
loreSummary: The year is 1962. The Cold War is at its peak. You and your fellow CIA operatives have been recruited to investigate Project MEDUSA, a dangerous Soviet bioweapons program.
roadmapTitle: 🕵️ CIA Covert Operations Dossier & Mission Timeline
keyFeatures: Operative Passports with customizable aliases, disguises, and forged documents
Two chances per month: Win and advance, or fail and attempt 'Late Month'
Scratch-off surveillance maps, covert CIA safehouses, and KGB tracker tokens
High-tension story unfolding across a 12-month calendar (plus Prologues)

pandemic_standard.name: Standard Expected Campaign (1-2 Prologues + ~4 Retries)
pandemic_standard.description: 1 training prologue plus 12 months with typical failure rate (~3-4 months requiring a 2nd attempt). Total 16-17 game plays.

pandemic_optimistic.name: Clean Operative Run (1 Prologue + 1 Retry)
pandemic_optimistic.description: High win rate run: 1 prologue and almost all months won on the first attempt (14 total games).

pandemic_grind.name: Hardcore Surveillance (2 Prologues + 7 Retries)
pandemic_grind.description: Struggling against heavy Soviet interference; several months go to 'Late [Month]' debriefings (21 total games).

pandemic_max.name: Maximum Legacy Box Capacity (24 Games + 2 Prologues)
pandemic_max.description: Every single calendar month played twice (Early + Late) plus both prologue missions (26 total games).

milestones.title: Project MEDUSA Unveiled
milestones.description: CIA operatives discover Soviet biochemical laboratories developing the weaponized MEDUSA pathogen.

milestones.title: The Defector Protocol
milestones.description: Extracting key Soviet research personnel across the Iron Curtain and establishing permanent surveillance safehouses.

milestones.title: Sleeper Contagion
milestones.description: Countering widespread sleeper cell infiltration and suppressing targeted biological incidents across Allied capitals.

milestones.title: Operation Final Dawn
milestones.phase: Operation Phase IV - The Central Hive
milestones.description: Infiltrating the central Soviet fortress to permanently dismantle the MEDUSA apparatus before New Year's Eve.
